The size every image is decoded to for training.

Every image is decoded once at this width and height when training starts (mode: exact stretches, fit pads, fill crops, center cuts out the middle unscaled) and kept in the project's cache/images; the compiler takes the model's input shape [H, W, C] from it, so the convolution layers after it know their sizes. Required for an image Data Input.

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Output shape | Width | `width` | Integer | `224` | `>0` | The run | Positive output width in pixels. Required. |
| Output shape | Height | `height` | Integer | `224` | `>0` | The run | Positive output height in pixels. Required. |
| Resize policy | Mode | `mode` | Choice | `exact` | `exact`, `fit`, `fill`, `center` | The run | Aspect-ratio and crop policy. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Resize is a training preprocessing contract node: the image batcher decodes to its width and height and the compiler takes the model's [H,W,C] input shape from it; PipelineExecutor image resizing is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Data Input (images) -> Resize -> Conv2D -> ... -> Flatten -> Dense
```
